# Column Value Validations {#sec-column-validations}

```{python}
#| include: false
import pointblank as pb
pb.config(report_incl_header=False, report_incl_footer=False)
```

This chapter covers Pointblank's column value methods in detail. It is the longest chapter in the
book because these are the methods you will use most. For each family we look at more than one
example, cover the edge cases that tend to trip people up, and talk about when to pick one method
over another. We start with comparisons and then move through ranges, set membership, null checks,
pattern matching, format specifications, string lengths, and ordered sequences. We finish with
column selectors, which let one step cover many columns, and the `dimension` argument, which ties a
check to the quality scoring of @sec-quality-scoring.
